events.text: You were married to {sa_name} in the life you came back from, and you buried {sa_him}: {sa_cause}, at {sa_age}. You have watched {sa_him} from a distance in this life, younger, laughing at nothing, alive. Tonight the memory comes back whole, and with it the date.

choices.text: Count the years on your fingers

effects.log: You count them twice. There is time. Not much, but time. (Saving the One You Couldn't, in the Jianghu)

choices.text: Go and find {sa_him}, just to look

effects.log: You find {sa_name} at the well, alive and annoyed about something small. You could weep. You do not, quite.

events.text: In the life you came back from, {sa_name} was a child of yours, and {sa_he} died of {sa_cause} at {sa_age}, and you were there and could do nothing. Now {sa_he} is here again, small, demanding a story before bed. Halfway through the story you remember the date, and your voice stops working.

effects.log: You finish the story. {sa_name} is asleep before the end. You sit by the bed until dawn, counting years.
{sa_name} squirms and complains. You let go. Not for long. (Saving the One You Couldn't, in the Jianghu)

events.text: You are small again, and {sa_name} is the grown-up who looks after you, just as before. And just as before, one day not so far off, {sa_name} will die of {sa_cause}. You remember the funeral. You remember being too young to stop it. You are not too young now. You are only small.

effects.log: You notice everything: the cough, the tired step, the shortcut by the river. Every one of them is a door you could close. (Saving the One You Couldn't, in the Jianghu)

choices.text: Take {sa_his} hand on the walk home

effects.log: {sa_name} is surprised, and pleased, and does not let go until the gate.

events.text: {sa_name} taught you everything once, in the life you came back from, and died of {sa_cause} at {sa_age} before you could repay a single lesson. In this life {sa_he} does not know you yet. Tonight, standing outside {sa_his} gate in the dark, you remember the day, and decide that this time you will repay all of it.

effects.log: {sa_name} opens the gate and looks at you as if at a stranger. You are one. Not for long. (Saving the One You Couldn't, in the Jianghu)

choices.text: Walk away and come back with a plan

effects.log: You go home and write everything you remember on one sheet of paper. It is a short sheet. It will have to be enough.

events.text: In the life you came back from, {sa_name} died of {sa_cause} at {sa_age}, and you were not there. This life you have been there for everything else: the first meeting, the first quarrel, the first laugh. Tonight you remember how it ended, and how soon.

effects.log: You say it to the dark room: not this time. The dark room does not argue. (Saving the One You Couldn't, in the Jianghu)
The hour, the road, the weather. You remember more than you expected. (Saving the One You Couldn't, in the Jianghu)

events.text: You tell {sa_name} not to take the river road in the spring of the year you remember, and why, as far as you can say why. {sa_He} looks at you for a long time. "You are serious," {sa_he} says. "You are actually afraid." Then: "All right. Not the river road."

effects.log: "Do not thank me," says {sa_name}. "Just tell me, one day, how you knew."
{sa_name} promises, half laughing, and means it.

events.text: You try to warn {sa_name}. It comes out wrong: too much, too exact, too frightened. {sa_He} laughs, then stops laughing, then changes the subject. You have planted something, but you cannot tell yet whether it will grow.

effects.log: You will try again. You have a little time left.

choices.text: Let it be, and watch instead

effects.log: Words are not the only way. You will be there.

events.text: You arrange your whole year around {sa_name}: the same market, the same road, the same tea house at dusk. {sa_He} starts to notice you everywhere, and decides it is luck. "You again," {sa_he} says, and makes room for you on the bench, every time.

effects.log: You sit down. You learn the shape of {sa_his} days by heart, and the places they are thin.
Every stone, every bridge. If the day comes on this road, you will know it better than it knows itself.

events.text: Last time {sa_name} died of {sa_cause}. This time you go looking for the beginning of it, years early, while it is still small enough to fight. You find it, and you break it, and you walk home with your knuckles bleeding and your heart lighter than it has been in two lives.

effects.log: Nobody will ever know what did not happen. That is the strange price of saving someone.
{sa_name} sees your knuckles and scolds you and wraps them. {sa_He} has no idea.

events.text: You go after the cause of it, years early, and it is bigger than you remembered, or you are smaller. You come home hurt, and no closer. But you have seen its face now. Next time you will know where to hit.

effects.log: You lie awake planning. The day is coming either way.

choices.text: Go again as soon as you can stand

effects.log: Not this year. Next year, if there is a next year.

events.text: You sit in the dark and walk back through the last life, the way a scholar walks back through a book. The day {sa_name} died. The day before. Who was there, what was said, what was not. And there it is: a small thing, exact as a needle, that nobody noticed at the time.

effects.log: You write it down before it slides away. A small exact thing is worth more than a large vague one.
You change it the next day. It takes an hour. It might be everything.

events.text: You try to walk back through the last life, and it will not hold still. Faces blur. Days run together. All you can hold on to is the end, which you would give anything to forget, and cannot.

effects.log: You stop. The end is still there when you close your eyes.
At dawn you have one new detail, small and probably useless. You keep it anyway.

events.text: {sa_name} says something today, word for word, that {sa_he} said in the last life, a week before the end. The same words, the same little laugh after. The world is trying to happen again the way it happened before.

effects.log: Last time you said nothing. This time you say something else, anything else. The laugh after is different too.
One more mark on the sheet of paper. The world rhymes, but you remember the rhymes.

events.text: You dream the last life again: {sa_name}, the day, {sa_cause}. In the dream you are always one step too late. You wake with your hand stretched out in front of you, reaching for someone who is, for now, asleep across the house.

effects.log: {sa_name} is asleep, breathing slow. You stand in the doorway until your hands stop shaking.
You train until dawn. Being one step too late is a thing that can be trained out.

events.text: Next year is the year. You have known it for so long that it has become a kind of furniture in your head. Now it is not furniture any more. {sa_name} is talking about next year's plans over the evening meal, and every plan is a road you remember.

effects.log: {sa_name} looks at your face and changes it without asking why. That is new.
From the year before, the day can be met. (Saving the One You Couldn't, in the Jianghu)

events.text: The day comes. It comes exactly as you remember, with the same light and the same wind, and you are standing in the one place it needed someone to stand. Then it is over, and {sa_name} is alive, irritated, asking why you are crying in the middle of the road.

effects.log: "It is not nothing," says {sa_name}. "But all right." {sa_He} walks you home.
You sit down in the road and laugh. {sa_name} sits down next to you, baffled, and after a while laughs too.

events.text: You were not ready. The day came anyway, and you were simply there, by luck or by the stubbornness of a soul that would not leave the same place twice. {sa_name} walks past {sa_cause} without ever knowing it was there.

effects.log: You breathe for what feels like the first time in two lives.
You thank the sky, the road, the luck. None of them answers. {sa_name} is alive. That is the answer.

events.text: You meet the day, and the day is stronger than you. {sa_name} dies of {sa_cause} at {sa_age}, as before, in almost the same place, with you close enough this time to hold {sa_his} hand. That is the only thing you changed. It is not nothing. It is not enough.

effects.log: You stay. You were there. In the last life you were not.
You walk until the city ends. Then you walk back, because there is a funeral, and you know how it goes.

events.text: The day comes before you are ready. You know the hour, the place, everything, and you are on the wrong side of the city when it happens. {sa_name} dies of {sa_cause} at {sa_age}, exactly as before. Knowing was not the same as being there.

choices.text: Sit down where you heard the news

effects.log: You sit down in the street. People step around you. Nobody asks.

choices.text: Swear it will not end here

effects.log: Your soul will carry {sa_name} to the next life, and the next, until one of them is the one.

events.text: {sa_name} is older now than {sa_he} ever got to be in the last life. {sa_He} does not know it, of course. {sa_He} just complains about grey hair and a sore knee, and every complaint is a year you did not have before.

effects.log: You trade complaints for an hour. It is the happiest hour of your month.
Every one of these days is new. You do not want to miss any of them.

events.text: {sa_name} does something today that {sa_he} never did in the last life, because in the last life there was no time: starts a garden, takes up the flute, goes on a long journey to see the sea. The world after the day is one you have never seen, and {sa_name} is in all of it.

effects.log: You go along. Everything is new, for both of you, for different reasons.
{sa_name} comes back with stories you have never heard, because they never happened before.

events.text: It is the anniversary. You have now lost {sa_name} twice, on the same day, of the same thing. People say grief gets smaller with time. They have not tried it across two lives.

effects.log: The grave is in the same place as last time. You know the way without looking.
You keep busy. At dusk it finds you anyway, and you let it.

events.text: Someone in the market laughs exactly like {sa_name} used to, and for a moment, before you turn your head, both lives are open at once and {sa_he} is alive in both. Then you turn your head.

choices.text: Buy something from the stall, to stay a moment

effects.log: You buy something you do not need, to hear the laugh again. It is a kindness to yourself.
You walk on. Your soul will remember {sa_name}. That is a promise and a burden both.

events.text: A stranger at a ferry crossing turns and smiles at you as if you have known each other forever, and you feel it too, a warmth with no reason behind it. Your soul once stood between someone and their death. The name {sa_past} comes into your head, from nowhere, and stays.

effects.log: You smile back. The ferry comes. The warmth stays with you all day.
You say it. The stranger looks puzzled, and then, for a moment, not at all.

events.text: Every year on the same date you are sad and cannot say why. This year the reason comes, faint as a voice under water: a name, {sa_past}, and a day you met and lost. Your soul is still carrying it.

choices.text: Light a lamp for a name you do not know

effects.log: You light it. It burns all night. You sleep better than you have in years.

choices.text: Promise the name you will do better

effects.log: You do not know what you are promising. Your soul does.
